name: Grit
author: Brooklyn Kray
description: Powerful, no-nonsense motivation, one tap away in your bar. Grit comes with a strong set of firm, honest lines to get you moving, but here's the real point: what actually fires you up is personal. That quote you saved, a line from someone you admire, your own style of motivation, add them in and you've built the one place that hits every single time.
